description: Defines the AppState class which manages the application's global state, user preferences, configuration handling, and interaction with external services such as gateway configuration, voice wake/sleep features, and UI preferences.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages application state, user settings, configuration, voice wake features, gateway configuration synchronization, and UI preferences.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AppState, loads user defaults, configuration files, and sets up watchers and initial state.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops configuration watcher.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Reads configuration from disk and applies overrides.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Applies specific configuration overrides from a loaded configuration dictionary.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Synchronizes current in-memory configuration with gateway config if changes are detected.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates voice ears for a specified TTL period.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake feature with permission management.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode with permission management.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets global voice wake triggers and suppresses immediate sync.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed task to synchronize voice wake triggers with gateway.

methods.name: loadChime
methods.description: Loads a stored chime configuration from user defaults.

methods.name: storeChime
methods.description: Stores a chime configuration into user defaults.
